xna-type.name: VertexElement
xna-type.summary: Defines input vertex data to the pipeline.

constructor.signature: VertexElement(short, short, VertexElementFormat, VertexElementMethod, VertexElementUsage, byte)
constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the VertexElement class.
constructor.syntax: public VertexElement ( short stream, short offset, VertexElementFormat elementFormat, VertexElementMethod elementMethod, VertexElementUsage elementUsage, byte usageIndex )

parameters.parameter: Offset (if any) from the beginning of the stream to the beginning of the vertex data.
One of several predefined types that define the vertex data size.
The tessellator processing method. These methods determine how the tessellator interprets/operates on the vertex data.
The intended use of the vertex data.
Modifies the usage data to allow the user to specify multiple usage types.

constructor.remarks: Vertex data is defined using an array of VertexElement structures.

property.name: Offset
property.summary: Retrieves or sets the offset (if any) from the beginning of the stream to the beginning of the vertex data.
property.value: Offset, in bytes, to the start of the vertex data.

property.name: Stream
property.summary: Retrieves or sets the stream number (or index) to use.

property.name: UsageIndex
property.summary: Modifies the usage data to allow the user to specify multiple usage types.
property.value: Byte that represents the usage index.
property.remarks: The UsageIndex property is used in conjunction with VertexElementUsage to specify the semantic of a vertex element.

property.name: VertexElementFormat
property.summary: Gets or sets the format of this vertex element.
property.value: The format of this vertex element.

property.name: VertexElementMethod
property.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating which vertex data to calculate during tessellation.
property.value: A value indicating which vertex data to calculate during tessellation.

property.name: VertexElementUsage
property.summary: Gets or sets a value describing how the vertex element is to be used.
property.value: A value describing how the vertex element is to be used.
